To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

we have developed a WGRH panel for hexaploid wheat, and this panel provides a low-cost resource to anchor and order sequenced BACs and NGS-based contigs for assembling high-quality reference sequences for hexaploid species.

we have developed and tested a whole genome radiation hybrid (WGBRH) panel for hexaploid wheat, and the panel will be useful in ordering sequenced contigs for assembling the reference sequence of wheat.

we developed a whole-genomic RH panel for reference wheat line CS, anchored and ordered sequenced BACs and next generation sequencing contigs, and developed a valuable resource for anchoring, ordering, and sequencing of hexaploid and polyploid genomes.
In summary, our research is concerned with
developing a WGRH map of hexaploid bread wheat and using it to anchor and order sequenced contigs for a high-quality, whole-genome sequence assembly.
development of a whole-genome RH panel for hexaploid wheat and the use of this resource to generate a contiguous, ordered sequence of the hexaploid wheat genome.
developing a WGRH resource for hexaploid wheat and its application for ordering sequenced Bacterial Artificial Chromosome (BAC) contigs and next generation sequencing contigs.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
our study provides a high-resolution WGRH resource that is useful for anchoring, ordering, and assembling sequenced BAC contigs and NGS contigs for hexaploid wheat.
the WGRH is a valuable tool for anchoring, ordering and orienting sequenced BACs and NGS based sequence scaffolds in hexaploid wheat and other complex genomes.

our research provides a valuable, low-cost, and efficient resource for anchoring sequenced BAC or NGS based contig maps and ordering them for assembling a high quality, reference sequence of a polyploid genome.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed a high-resolution, whole-genome RH panel for hexaploid wheat and have demonstrated its utility by anchoring and ordering a set of 7296 sequenced BACs.
we developed and tested a whole genome radiation hybrid (WCRH) resource for reference wheat line, Chinese Spring (CS).
we have developed a WGRH resource for hexaploid wheat that provides a high-resolution, contiguous and ordered map for anchoring and orienting sequenced BAC or NGS contigs.
The main takeaway from our work is that
WGRH mapping is a valuable resource for mapping and ordering of sequenced BAC/NGS contigs for assembling high-quality, whole-genome reference sequences of complex genomes such as hexaploids.
WGRH can be a powerful resource for anchoring, ordering, and orientation of sequenced contigs and can provide a high-resolution, physical reference sequence for complex polyploid genomes.
the CS-WGRH resource is a cost-effective tool for anchoring and/or ordering of BAC and NGA based sequencing contigs, and for anchoring and fine-scale ordering of genetic markers in hexaploid wheat.
